title: About the Event
content: CII uses cookies to improve your website & conference experiences, including enhancing website navigation, personalized features & promotions, evaluating our services, and customizing content and ads based on your preferences as you browse or engage with us. By clicking "Continue" or continuing to use our site, you are agreeing to our and our partners use of cookies. See our Privacy Policy for more information. The Bio-IT World Conference & Expo is the leading international gathering where life sciences, technology, and healthcare converge to drive the future of precision medicine. Now in its 25th year, Bio-IT World unites more than 2,900 researchers, clinicians, data scientists, IT specialists, and technology leaders from across pharma, biotech, clinical research, informatics, and healthcare. The program spans 200+ educational sessions, including visionary keynotes, in-depth symposia, technical workshops, interactive panels, and hands-on demonstrations. Attendees gain unparalleled opportunities to connect with peers, explore an exhibit hall of cutting-edge solutions, and engage with thought leaders shaping biomedical research, drug discovery, and patient care. Discussions will continue to explore the most exciting frontiers in life sciences and technology: AI and generative AI, machine learning, cloud and data science, multimodal and real-world data strategies, FAIR and open science principles, robotics and lab automation, pilot programs, emerging product launches, and biotech investment trends. Bio-IT World is more than a conference - it is a community where data and technology are transformed into actionable insights, measurable value, and real-world impact. Join us in Boston, May 19–21, 2026, to be part of the conversations and collaborations that are advancing science, accelerating discovery, and improving patient outcomes worldwide. Experience the only event that takes a uniquely holistic view of the technologies, strategies, and collaborations driving the future of precision medicine - connecting science, data, and innovation across the full R&D and healthcare ecosystem. Discover the latest advancements and best practices in areas transforming the industry: generative AI at scale, quantum computing for drug discovery, knowledge graphs in precision medicine, large language models (LLMs), robotics and lab automation, and more. Learn from 300+ of the most influential voices in biopharma, technology, academia, and investment as they share case studies, strategies, and lessons learned through interactive presentations, panels, and discussions. Gain unparalleled perspective from visionary plenary keynotes and exclusive panels that unite diverse leaders to explore collaborative technologies, emerging trends, and the next wave of transformative innovation. Deepen your expertise through workshops and symposia featuring focused sessions on Knowledge Graphs, Generative AI Tools, FAIR Data, Quantum Computing, Digital Biopharma, Preparing Data for AI, AI in Antibody Design, and other frontier topics. Network with 2,900+ peers from around the globe, building meaningful connections with life science professionals, innovators, and investors who are working together to accelerate discovery, development, and patient impact. Shape your own experience across 3 days of interactive learning with a fully customizable program - choose from 11 conference tracks, “track-hop” between concurrent sessions, and revisit key content on-demand to maximize learning and value. 250 First Avenue, Suite 300 Needham, MA 02494 P: 781.972.5400 F: 781.972.5425 E: [email protected]
